records.text: Noor keeps her kayak at the Pinecrest boathouse. It is painted yellow.
Tobias stores his kayak in his garage on Elm Street.
Noor is allergic to peanuts and carries an epinephrine pen.
Tobias is employed as a structural engineer at Calder Bridgeworks.
The rooftop greenhouse is watered every morning at seven by the irrigation timer.
The greenhouse door has a combination lock that was replaced in May.
Pepper, the family dog, sees Dr. Okafor at the Riverside Animal Clinic.
Pepper eats a salmon-based kibble twice a day.
The book club is reading The Glass Orchard this month and meets at Wren's apartment.
The apartment lease renews on the first of March each year.
The hatchback had its brakes serviced at Mile Marker Garage in August.
Car insurance is provided by Northgate Mutual.
Ines flies to Lisbon on the 14th for the architecture conference.
During the conference Ines stays at the Alfama Courtyard Hotel.
The next dental cleaning is booked with Dr. Haldane for 9 a.m. on Thursday.
The shed key is kept under the blue planter by the back steps.
The home router was replaced with a mesh system in January.
Wren sings alto in the community choir.
Tobias goes rock climbing at the Summit Wall gym on Wednesdays.
While Noor is away, her neighbour Kesh waters the balcony plants.
Ines drinks her coffee black.
